video_title: Is Jalen Brunson UNDERRATED as a star? 👀 Iman Shumpert says YES, BUT... | First Take

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on Jalen Brunson's status as an underrated player
quotes.excerpt: I think he's still underrated in the league, and he keeps proving people wrong.
quotes.quote: As a friend, you're happy he's getting recognition. I think he's still underrated in the league, and he keeps proving people wrong, game by game, series by series, playoff appearance by playoff appearance. As a friend and a teammate, it's funny because you know he's one of the best players in the league, and you're happy that he's starting to get some recognition.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on why Jalen Brunson is underrated
quotes.excerpt: We're not used to seeing a small guard win at this rate.
quotes.quote: It's a two-part answer. I feel like two things can be true at once. He is underrated, but that's because we're not used to seeing a small guard win at this rate. Anytime he has any deficiencies in his game or he doesn't shoot it well, we like to key in on it. But I can't say he's underrated around the league because you still got to put eyes on him, you still got to have a scheme for him.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Jalen Brunson's value compared to Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is at least as valuable as Luka Doncic.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is at least as valuable as Luka Doncic, because Jalen Brunson is not a great defender, but he doesn't take an 'I don't give a damn about half the game' approach. He's a willing defender. If I compare him to an early Steph, the effort is there. He might not be there, but he won't let somebody just blow by him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Jalen Brunson's All-NBA recognition
quotes.excerpt: He was second team All-NBA this year. That's saying he's a top 10 player.
quotes.quote: He was second team All-NBA this year. That's saying he's a top 10 player. Last year he won clutch player of the year. That's an acknowledgement by everybody that he is one of the best. This year he didn't finish top three, but he's been clutch player of the year.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on defending Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: If I had to prepare for him, I would prepare like I was preparing for James Harden.
quotes.quote: You can't foul. You got to keep your hand out of the cookie jar. If I had to prepare for him, I would prepare like I was preparing for James Harden. Keep your hand out of the cookie jar, strong, stay in a good stance, always stay between him and the basket, and wait on the second and third shot fake.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the similarities between left-handed players
quotes.excerpt: If you look at a lot of left-handed players, all of them kind of have similar DNA.
quotes.quote: If you look at a lot of left-handed players, all of them kind of have similar DNA. They attack at a different angle because they're left-handed. They look for deficiencies with us because we're predominantly right-handed. They look for little things that they can do to get you in foul trouble. If they can't get you in foul trouble, they get you to hesitate.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Spurs' defensive strategy against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I think the Spurs are looking at this going, look he took 32 shots to score 30 points.
quotes.quote: I think the Spurs are looking at this going, look he took 32 shots to score 30 points. We'll live with that. We just got to score more than 95. And so I think they're looking at their end saying, obviously we don't want him going off three, four times in a row in the end of the game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Anthony Edwards's opinion of Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: The person whose opinion matters on this question is Anthony Edwards.
quotes.quote: The person whose opinion matters on this question is Anthony Edwards. What is Anthony Edwards's opinion of this? Because Anthony Edwards's life has changed since Karl-Anthony Towns left. And I'm not criticizing Julius Randle. They double team Ant. Edwards hates being double teamed so much and they couldn't double team him like that when Karl-Anthony Towns was there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Knicks' front office moves
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks have Jalen Brunson, they have OG Anunoby, they have Mikal Bridges, and they have Karl-Anthony Towns.
quotes.quote: The Knicks have Jalen Brunson, they have OG Anunoby, they have Mikal Bridges, and they have Karl-Anthony Towns, and they ain't in the second apron because they maneuvered it with Karl-Anthony Towns largely because Brunson was also willing to take the pay cut.
